svg.title: NovaVision: text to image, separate validation, and saved pilot evidence
svg.desc: Write English text and choose a visual style. Estimate seven emotion scores, pleasantness, and activation. Shape the prompt with mood, palette, lighting, and composition. Neutral selects raw; other labels select affect. Render an image with the configured backend, seed, and dimensions. The default backend produces synthetic test images. Separate experiments start with known targets, compare raw, naive, emotion, and affect using shared seeds, generate images, and compare image-probe predictions with intended labels. The saved SD-Turbo and CLIP ViT-B/32 CPU pilot used 256 by 256 images, two subjects, one seed, and 14 images per measured condition. Raw recovery was 2 of 14, or 14.29 percent, with a bootstrap 95 percent interval of 0 to 35.71 percent. Emotion and affect each recovered 3 of 14, or 21.43 percent, with intervals of 0 to 42.86 percent. Chance agreement is 14.29 percent. Neutral predictions occurred in 38 of 42 images, or 90.5 percent. Naive is unmeasured. The pilot does not demonstrate improved emotion control.
